query: SELECT m.mailbox_id AS "id!" FROM businesses.team_member m JOIN businesses.business b ON b.id = m.business_id WHERE CASE WHEN b.status = 'removed' THEN b.status_changed_at >= $1::timestamptz ELSE m.removed_at IS NULL OR m.removed_at >= $1::timestamptz END UNION SELECT a.mailbox_id FROM businesses.backup_address a JOIN businesses.team_member m ON m.id = a.member_id JOIN businesses.business b ON b.id = a.business_id WHERE CASE WHEN b.status = 'removed' THEN b.status_changed_at >= $1::timestamptz ELSE (a.removed_at IS NULL AND m.removed_at IS NULL) OR a.removed_at >= $1::timestamptz OR m.removed_at >= $1::timestamptz END UNION SELECT v.id FROM businesses.mailbox_check c JOIN businesses.business b ON b.id = c.business_id LEFT JOIN businesses.team_member m ON m.id = COALESCE(c.change_for, c.member_id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (c.mailbox_id), (c.replaces)) AS v (id) WHERE v.id IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN b.status = 'removed' THEN b.status_changed_at >= $1::timestamptz ELSE (c.open AND m.removed_at IS NULL) OR m.removed_at >= $1::timestamptz OR COALESCE(c.verified_at, c.sent_at) >= $1::timestamptz END
